headline: AMAROQ DRILLS 132.5 g/t AU AT NALUNAQ — 43 g/t Average Across 37 Underground Holes; 30% of Results Exceed 60 g/t in Greenland
snippet: Amaroq Minerals (AIM/TSX: AMRQ) released 37 underground drill holes from Nalunaq Mine in southern Greenland averaging 42.8 g/t Au — 16 holes exceeded the 30 g/t resource grade, 30% came in above 60 g/t, and headline intersections reached 132.5 g/t over 0.50m and 132.0 g/t over 0.50m on the 802 and 773 Levels. Results confirm stope confidence ahead of mining; completion will allow the drill to relocate to the 810 Level for systematic resource growth drilling from the planned exploration drift.

headline: AVANTI RUSHES TO 6 RIGS AT MISISI — Doubles Fleet to 4 Immediately as Largest-Ever DRC Gold Program Accelerates (CSE:AGC)
source_name: Investing News Network / Avanti Gold Corp.
snippet: Avanti Gold (CSE: AGC) immediately expanded its active drill fleet at the Misisi Gold Project in the DRC's Kibara Gold Belt from two to four rigs, with a sixth rig expected on site by end of July — the fastest mobilisation in the project's history against a 3.11 Moz NI 43-101 Inferred resource. A new RC pre-collar rig will pre-collar holes through weathered overburden, freeing the diamond rigs to focus exclusively on mineralised core zones to improve daily meterage and reduce unit cost on the largest exploration program ever run at Misisi.

headline: KINROSS EARNS IN FOR $20M AT PWC — Wenban Limestone Mirrors Fourmile Geology; Cortez Drill Targets Set for Summer (Riley Gold)
snippet: Kinross Gold has completed 2026 exploration planning at Riley Gold's Pipeline West/Clipper (PWC) project in Nevada's Cortez mining district, identifying new framework drill targets in never-tested Wenban limestone stratigraphy that mirrors the geology of the nearby Fourmile discovery. Kinross is earning up to 75% of PWC by spending US$20 million; updated 3D modelling integrates seismic, IP, geochemical, and historical drill data, with first holes expected in the current summer field season.

headline: MILITARY METALS DRILLS CANADA'S HISTORIC ANTIMONY MINE — West Gore Nova Scotia Back Under Drill for First Time Since WWI (CSE:MILI)
snippet: Military Metals Corp. (CSE: MILI) launched a seven-hole, 1,750-metre diamond drill campaign at West Gore in Nova Scotia — one of Canada's most historically significant antimony mines, with commercial production running from 1883 until WWI when a concentrate ship was torpedoed. Three holes target the down-plunge extension of the past-producing deposit below existing workings; four target the Brook Vein; historical samples returned grades of 40.6% Sb and 106.5 g/t Au, and antimony is a federally designated critical mineral essential for defence and clean-tech applications.

headline: GOLDSTORM DRILLS ADJACENT TO BRUCEJACK AND KSM — 3,000m Targets Copernicus Cu-Au Anomaly in 80Moz Golden Triangle (TSXV:GSTM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Goldstorm Metals Corp.
snippet: Goldstorm Metals (TSX-V: GSTM) commenced a 3,000-metre Phase 1 diamond drill program on July 15 at its 100%-owned Crown copper-gold-silver property in BC's Golden Triangle, targeting the Copernicus Cu-Au trend that overlies a 1.2-kilometre IP chargeability anomaly. The Crown property sits to the south of Newmont's Brucejack Mine and Seabridge Gold's KSM project in a district hosting more than 80 million ounces of gold and 20 billion pounds of copper, with additional prospecting at the high-grade Delta West discovery zone planned alongside drilling.

headline: NOBLE PLAINS GOES UNDERGROUND AT DUCK CREEK — University of Wyoming Seismic Maps Hidden Roll-Fronts in Powder River Basin (TSXV:NOBL)
snippet: Noble Plains Uranium (TSX-V: NOBL) launched a joint seismic reflection and IP geophysics program with the University of Wyoming at its Duck Creek project in Wyoming's Powder River Basin to image buried shallow Wasatch and deeper Fort Union uranium mineralization. The existing NI 43-101 resource of 5.32 million indicated pounds of U3O8 was built from just 2.5 miles of a 5.25-mile trend; the program will cover the remaining ~2.75 miles and the deeper formation that current drilling has not reached economically.

headline: FIRST EVER DRILL AT EXCALIBUR BC PORPHYRY — 1km×2km Copper-Gold Target in Babine District Near Former Huckleberry Mine (CSE:PRR)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Prospect Ridge Resources Corp.
snippet: Prospect Ridge Resources (CSE: PRR) commenced the maiden drill program at its 100%-owned Excalibur copper-gold porphyry target on July 14 — a 1 km × 2 km, never-before-drilled anomaly in BC's Babine porphyry belt, positioned near the former Huckleberry, Bell, and Granisle mines. The 3,000-metre inaugural program targets a large IP chargeability feature interpreted as a classic pyrite halo flanking magnetite-rich potassic alteration, the defining geophysical signature of buried copper-bearing porphyry systems.

headline: METALLIS TURNS FIRST DRILL AT GREYHOUND IDAHO — Rufus Zone Targets Silver-Gold-Antimony Shear; Critical Minerals Angle Sharpens (TSXV:MTS)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Metallis Resources Inc.
snippet: Metallis Resources (TSX-V: MTS) commenced diamond drilling at its Greyhound Property in central Idaho on July 16, with the first hole GH26-12 targeting the 1350 Zone within the Rufus system — a broad shear zone carrying polymetallic quartz-sulphide veins with anomalous gold, silver, antimony, lead, and zinc. The 3,000-metre 2026 program builds on 2025 work that confirmed shear zone continuity; antimony's critical mineral designation and tight ex-China supply add strategic appeal to the polymetallic target package.

headline: STELLAR AFRICAGOLD AUGERS 10,000m IN COTE D'IVOIRE — Six Refined Targets Advance West Africa Gold Belt to Pre-Drill Stage (TSXV:SPX)
snippet: Stellar AfricaGold (TSX-V: SPX) commenced a 10,000-metre auger drill program across six refined targets within the Fifty-Five, Central, and South East prospects on its 395.78 km² Zuénoula permit in Côte d'Ivoire on July 15. Auger results will be used to prioritize targets before advancing to RC and diamond drilling expected in late 2026; recent infill soil sampling extended Drill Target T1 at the Fifty-Five Prospect to a 3.3-kilometre strike length, signalling district-scale gold potential across the permit.

headline: MAKENITA FINDS DRILL-READY MAGNETIC ANOMALY AT SISSON WEST — Adjacent to PM-Designated Tungsten Nation-Building Project, NB (CSE:KENY)
snippet: Makenita Resources (CSE: KENY) announced on July 17 that compiled airborne and regional data have identified a clearly defined magnetic high on its Sisson West Tungsten Project in New Brunswick, directly adjacent to the Sisson Tungsten Deposit — one of the Prime Minister's first designated nation-building critical minerals projects. The magnetic high displays characteristics similar to the Sisson deposit itself; the company is immediately formulating a drill program to test the target on its 9,400-acre land position.

headline: VANECK: GOLD STOCKS UP 46% YOY AND STILL CHEAP — Record Margins at $4,000 Make Mining Equities Standout Trade Into Q2 Earnings
snippet: VanEck precious metals portfolio manager Imaru Casanova told Kitco on July 14 that gold mining equities — up 46% year-over-year versus gold's 22% gain — remain the standout trade despite the current pullback, because stocks still trade well below historical price-to-NAV ratios while generating record margins with AISC below $2,000/oz at $4,000 gold. She characterises the correction from January's $5,589 peak as noise rather than a reversal, and argues the entry point into Q2 earnings season — where producers will report average realised prices near $4,700/oz — is compelling for positioning ahead of expected institutional recognition.

headline: METALSOURCE IP MAPS 2.4km TARGET AT SILVER HILL — History Shows 209 g/t Au, 241 g/t Ag, 39% Zn; Drill Plan Now in Hand (CSE:MSM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Metalsource Mining Corp.
snippet: Metalsource Mining (CSE: MSM) announced on July 16 that an IP survey at its Silver Hill project has delineated approximately 2.4 kilometres of prospective strike across two priority drill target areas — a continuous 1.8-kilometre southern anomaly and a 600-metre northeast zone — providing a defined drill-target package for the next exploration phase. Historical intercepts from the Silver Hill area include composite assay results up to 209 g/t Au, 241 g/t Ag, 18.8% Pb, 39.4% Zn, and 5.4% Cu, indicating a significant polymetallic system beneath the anomalies.
